summary: Polling only the last 1,024 transcript items breaks TUI chat scrollback and search for earlier history because PendingPrefix only converts what is already in the polled snapshot.
TurnReviewHost receives the 1,024-item windowed snapshot from the poller, causing seed_from_session to lose the opening task and earlier user intent/trajectory on long sessions.
Truncating to 1,024 raw transcript items before raw_only filtering can leave the browser transcript with far fewer than 1,000 visible lines or empty.
Dashboard detail recomputes unread agent messages, unread restarts, and last user/agent message previews solely from the 1,024-item transcript window, losing them after long tool/thought stretches.

load_materialized_projection_tail_from derives latest_user_position via last_materialized_user_message, which skips user items with blank or stripped visible text, diverging from ProjectionWindow::of and missing completed turns.
load_materialized_projection_tail_from performs O(N) SQLite index scans per poll via COUNT(*) for unused omitted_items and linear user-message scans over materialized_transcript_position.
first_materialized_user_message filters user rows by stable_id prefix (user:* or user-*), skipping valid restored user items with other stable IDs that MaterializedSession::resolved_title accepts.
OwnedMcpApprovals::response delegates to allow_permission_response, which falls back to PermissionOptionKind::AllowAlways if a DSH permission request omits AllowOnce.

Steering an active prompt with a queued prompt replaces active_turn and emits a second turn_started for the queued command ID, while completion still arrives under the original command ID with no matching active_turn.

When provisioning fails and target cleanup succeeds, rollback deletes the provisional session row without setting last_error, so neither error trigger fires and record_api_error skips the deleted session.
Rejecting requests where after_seq and Last-Event-ID differ breaks standard SSE EventSource automatic reconnection after receiving any event.
mj events writes and flushes stdout outside its ctrl_c() select, so Ctrl-C hangs once Tokio's SIGINT handler is installed and stdout is backpressured by a full pipe.
Prompt RPC failures emit an error event whose message is only the literal stop_reason 'error', dropping the diagnostic text journaled in the preceding Warning observation.
Using (?2 IS NULL OR e.session_id = ?2) and (?3 IS NULL OR w.workspace_id = ?3) in load_api_events_from prevents SQLite from using the session/workspace indexes at prepare time.
InputResolved reads current.active_turn at resolution time, which can be None or the next turn when Muse permission handling responds to ACP before emitting ElicitationResolved.
An error from record_activity_stream wins the top-level tokio::select! in mj-cli/src/server.rs, terminating the viewer and dropping the control future before its shutdown cleanup runs.
Passing the unbounded wrapped quota line count as Constraint::Length in inline (20-row capped) and fullscreen layouts can starve the Min(5) chat input area and clip quota or transcript rows.
from_usage_meta only checks that DeepSeek balance amount strings are non-empty, allowing non-numeric malformed strings to overwrite the last known good balance status.
Deleting `a_harness_restart_gates_dispatch_until_the_session_is_configured_again` removes the sole regression test for closing and reopening the worker dispatch gate across ACP bridge restarts.
Deleting `embedded_npm_recipes_match_the_runtime_pins` removes the only check tying the embedded Codex/Claude package.json manifests to the runtime version pins.
Deleting `daemon_restart_without_a_baseline_does_not_hide_pending_work` removes the only test verifying that restarting an existing relay without a review baseline leaves the Git ref absent.
Deleting `project_memory_requests_read_snapshots_and_advance_the_baseline` removes the only test exercising the worker's `ProjectMemorySnapshot` and `InstallProjectMemorySnapshot` relay handlers.
Deleting `an_unanswered_handback_tells_the_child_to_call_again` removes a pure unit test on `unanswered_reply`.
Deleting `an_unparsable_codex_config_is_reported_rather_than_overwritten` removes a pure input-validation unit test on `pin_accepted_bridge_selectors`.
Deleting `a_wait_for_any_child_carries_return_when_and_the_harness_default` leaves no MCP-socket test asserting that `wait` forwards `return_when` and the Codex default timeout on the wire.
Deleting `reviewer_fast_mode_is_applied_when_advertised_and_optional_otherwise` removes the only ACP fixture test for reviewer fast-mode application and fallback when absent or rejected.
Deleting `muse_incomplete_install_requires_both_executables` removes the only non-ignored test verifying that `complete_install` rejects a cached Muse install missing `bin/muse`.
Pressing and holding Enter on a failed checkpointed session can confirm Recover and advance through the Resume wizard to submission before the prompt is drawn.
A long or multi-line error in `Confirmation::RecoverFailed` can push the explanatory text and action buttons past the bottom of the non-scrolling modal.
Answering a turn-review role's elicitation spawns an extra permanent polling loop for that role.
A turn-review elicitation can reopen while its submitted answer is in flight, and answering it again fails the review.
Metadata-only raw snapshots without saved review refs leave review_refs_metadata_only false, allowing explicit restores to check out the archived HEAD.
Metadata-only review-ref archives reuse archive schema version 10 instead of bumping the schema version.
After removing the destination-baseline refusal, resuming a review-enabled raw session into a shared checkout still overwrites the other live session's baseline pin during worker startup.
Prompts submitted while a config update is in flight are discarded by the runtime, leaving the UI permanently stuck in TurnState::Streaming.
Refreshing config options while the picker is open only clamps numeric indices rather than preserving selected option and value IDs.
The config picker modal height formula omits one row of chrome, leaving zero list rows when there is a single item and clipping one row for larger lists.
In very small terminals where the config picker cannot render, it remains open and still intercepts navigation and Enter to apply settings blindly.
Embedded newlines in option or value descriptions cause multi-row ListItems that break the picker's one-row-per-item scroll window.
Closing the legacy default workspace skips composer disposal on the runtime feed, so other attached dashboard clients retain and can restore discarded drafts.
If the follow-up snapshot or workspace list reload fails after close_workspace succeeds, the client reports the close as failed and skips deletion cleanup.
discard_workspace_composers does not clear standby composer drafts, allowing unsent text typed during startup/attach to reappear when the session is resumed.
Workspace close checks cancellation only before calling close_session, so cancelling during an irreversible child teardown still starts stopping subsequent children and the parent.
The workspace close cancellation loop cancels whatever lifecycle currently owns each session from the initial snapshot, which can cancel an unrelated resume in another workspace.
Wrapping wide graphemes after a continuation indent can exceed the line width and get clipped by the fixed-width Paragraph.
Starting a nested tight list does not flush the buffered parent list item, so the child item overwrites item_prefix and merges parent and child text onto one line.
Rich Markdown rendering discards link destinations without emitting clickable hyperlinks, hiding URLs for Markdown links and ACP ResourceLinks.
Header-only Markdown tables wider than the viewport emit no lines in the narrow record fallback.
Grid table layout computes width per row independently and joins cells without column padding, misaligning columns and misjudging whether the grid fits.
Per-chunk terminal sanitization turns a CRLF sequence split across two streamed chunks into two newlines.
An intervening first Plan update becomes the last transcript entry and splits a streamed message across two entries even when message_id matches.
The image worker probe uses `test -e`, which treats a dangling symlink at /opt/mjolnir/mj-worker as absent instead of failing as an unusable worker.
The agent-dev image publish workflow lacks concurrency control, so an older run finishing after a newer push can overwrite :latest with a stale worker.
The Docker image-worker integration test assumes agent-dev:latest has no worker before mutating the container, so it fails once the newly published image is pulled.
Worker recovery and parked subagent wake still use host-binary digest comparison, overwriting the image-worker symlink with a copied host binary.
Requiring worker build-args in Containerfile.agent-dev breaks the raw `podman build` command still documented in PODMAN.md.
show_close_failure is never called from src/hel_main.rs, leaving the recovery dialog unreachable and removing the only dashboard path to force-destroy after a failed close.

Inserting the lossy transcript label into cross-harness resume profile rows causes them to wrap inside an unscrollable picker sized for one line per choice, pushing choices and the selection marker off-screen.
Worker re-exec clears the container-injected GH_TOKEN before configure_github_cli can seed the session token file and before worker push-branch runs.
spawn_shell removes GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN after applying spawn.env, stripping tokens explicitly requested via ACP terminal/create.
The clean login bootstrap removes RUSTUP_HOME and CARGO_HOME from the Rust base image and Containerfile.agent-dev's login profile does not restore them.
Bootstrapping from an empty-environment login shell breaks custom container images by discarding image ENV (PATH, MUSE_CLI) and requiring a working login shell and home directory.
Clearing the worker environment on re-exec drops SSH_AUTH_SOCK, breaking SSH-agent-authenticated Git operations in sessions and worker push-branch.
bootstrap_login_environment does not restore target_environment for worker push-branch and worker diff, dropping configured target variables such as HTTPS_PROXY or SSH_AUTH_SOCK.
Re-merging spec.environment onto the cached login/target snapshot via with_overrides restores GIT_CONFIG_COUNT and GIT_CONFIG_KEY_*/VALUE_* that configure_git_config_file removed.
capture-checkpoint, export-checkpoint, and restore-checkpoint are omitted from bootstrap_login_environment and still run SystemGit with the uncleaned launcher environment.

On login-capture timeout, CancellableProcessExecutor::execute joins the stdout/stderr reader threads unconditionally, which hangs past the deadline if a login profile spawns a new-session helper keeping those pipes open.
When the capacity poller trigger channel is closed, the 500 response returns reference `capacity-poller`, but the daemon warning log omits that reference so searching the log cannot find the failure.

`resolve_repository` unconditionally wraps all errors from `resolve_local_repository` in `Refusal::precondition`, misclassifying Git launch/execution, filesystem, timeout, and cancellation failures as 409 missing-remote refusals without a daemon-log reference.

`RefreshCapacity` validates `target_id` against configured target IDs in HTTP validation but looks it up against probe IDs (`local`, `ssh:<host>`, `aws:<target_id>`) in `capacity_state`, causing the new 422 refusal to falsely claim valid configured targets like `podman` are unconfigured.

`download_model_file` uses a fixed `dest.with_extension("part")` temporary path and unlinks it before downloading, allowing concurrent workers to rename another worker's incomplete file into the cache where `has_model_data` treats any nonempty file as installed.

`dictation_prompt_title` places the full model filename before the percentage and `Ctrl-R stop` hint in a single-line border title, so narrow terminals (~48-60 columns) clip the download progress percentage and stop shortcut.

In `draw_input`, `busy_prompt_title(state)` takes precedence over `state.voice_input_active`, so starting dictation during an active agent turn hides the new setup progress and `Ctrl-R stop` hint until the turn finishes.

`dictation_prompt_title` reads the shared `state.status_line`, so an agent turn finishing with no queued prompt overwrites it with `turn done: ...` and replaces the active dictation setup status until the worker emits another update.
Restoring a saved transcript position matches only start_seq, so two entries emitted by the same event ordinal collide on the first entry.
Interpreting legacy Row.entry handoff indexes as full-history indexes cannot distinguish legacy positions saved before prefix conversion finished.
Falling back to session/new after a failed session/load leaves session_updates_enabled false, silently dropping all subsequent session/update notifications.

Pre-upgrade relay snapshots lack native_session_used and do not replay already-applied SessionOpened { resumed: true } or autonomous turns, allowing silent replacement of imported or previously resumed threads.

A successful resume marks native_session_used in the durable snapshot but not in the live ACP bridge atomic, so a subsequent in-process bridge restart still passes native_session_may_have_history = false.
Removing a queued prompt before dispatch transitions its state to Rejected, which native_session_may_have_history treats as evidence that the thread was used.
Adding native_session_used to RelaySnapshot without bumping RELAY_STATE_VERSION prevents older workers from reading snapshots where native_session_used is true.

Bundle export always refuses bare sessions (both managed worktrees and unmanaged bare checkouts) with 'no commits beyond the session base' because it reuses checkpoint archives whose committed bundles are always empty.
Bundle export for managed network workspaces omits commits already pushed to origin and refuses with 'no commits beyond the session base' after a push.
Diff export always fails with 'no session base recorded' for unmanaged bare checkout sessions.

File export for bare sessions passes the parent of project_directory as the security boundary root, exposing sibling files and sibling worktrees outside the session checkout and breaking project-relative paths.
Diff export for a bare session started in a subdirectory of a repository stages only that subdirectory into an empty scratch index and reports all tracked files outside it as deleted.
Diff export falsely reports unchanged tracked files that match .gitignore rules as deleted because capture_worktree_tree stages into an empty scratch index.
Diff export corrupts non-UTF-8 text file patches via String::from_utf8_lossy.
read_session_file has a TOCTOU window between canonicalization, metadata validation, and fs::read, allowing symlink swaps or files growing past the 16 MiB limit.
Bundle export runs checkpoint_session_now directly inside the HTTP handler, blocking Tokio workers on synchronous DB/subprocess work and skipping completion/rollback if the HTTP request is dropped.
A concurrent checkpoint or close can prune the selected checkpoint archive before bundle verification finishes reading and reopening it.
create_managed_worktree creates the new branch from HEAD rather than the previously recorded base_commit.
Losing terminal focus while dragging the resume preview scrollbar leaves its drag state set, causing wheel events to be swallowed when focus returns.
Pasting a search query on the Live tab discards the returned index search action, leaving history tabs with stale results after switching tabs.
rebuild_resume_rows runs the full history merge and sort even on an unfiltered Live tab, then immediately discards the result.
Title- and project-only search matches no longer populate WikiRow.preview, dropping their conversation excerpt from the resume dialog and search results.
Typing a new query on the Live tab immediately computes history tab hit counts from the previous query's (or unfiltered recent) cached wiki rows before the new search returns.
RecoveryCoordinator drops an idle observation received while a deferred copy still holds the gate, leaving the completed turn uncheckpointed until the next session activity.
TurnReviewHost overwrites prompt_driven when a self-started turn follows a prompt-driven turn without an observed idle boundary, dropping the automatic review for the completed prompt.
Deferred checkpoints skip packing and never remove the uniquely named checkpoint-stage-capture-* directory prestaged on the target, leaking disk space across retries.

Under HoldThroughClose, a self-started harness turn during export or transfer triggers CheckpointDeferred in revalidation, aborting close and recording a checkpoint error instead of waiting the turn out.
Manual checkpoint clears last_checkpoint_error before attempting the copy and skips restoring it on deferral, erasing a pre-existing checkpoint failure warning without producing a new archive.

installation_home calls std::fs::canonicalize synchronously from Dashboard::setup_discovered -> Config::setup_additions on the TUI event loop, which can freeze the UI on slow or unavailable filesystems.
installation_home expands ~ so a TOML profile using ~/.claude suppresses discovery of the working absolute home, while profile consumers still use the unexpanded literal path.

When canonicalize fails because of a missing intermediate component under a symlinked ancestor, the lexical fallback leaves the symlinked prefix unresolved, mismatching the canonicalized discovered path and adding a duplicate profile.
When canonicalize fails on a path containing an existing symlink followed by .., the lexical fallback collapses symlink/.. as an ordinary directory and can falsely suppress a distinct installation.

spawn_config_rename wraps both the daemon rename RPC and the subsequent local configuration reload under SAVE_ACK_TIMEOUT, misreporting a slow reload after a confirmed rename as an unacknowledged daemon save and discarding the reload result.

When the primary has a configured reasoning_effort and an inline /load falls back to restart, comparing roster.primary against the roster.available entry from provenance lookup misclassifies a same-route session as a cross-agent import.

If the staged source-adapter replay fails with UiEvent::Fatal (e.g., deleted session or rejected session/load), ui_loop never exits back to run_app, stranding the user in a read-only source-adapter view after the primary has shut down.

When a source adapter advertises session/resume without load_session, the ACP runtime falls back to session/resume without replaying history yet still emits SessionStarted { resumed: true }, causing import to exit immediately and start a fresh primary with an empty transcript.

ClipboardTarget omits the focused elicitation answer field and does not detect focus round-trips through overlays such as the earlier-messages reader, allowing stale clipboard reads to paste into the wrong field.
Discarding a stale clipboard read clears paste_in_flight without retiring the "Reading clipboard…" progress notice.
is_missing_program in targets/preflight.rs duplicates is_missing_command in controller/backend.rs.
docker_daemon_not_running misses newer Docker CLI stopped-daemon diagnostics, misclassifying them as DockerUnavailable::NotAnswering instead of NotRunning.
A timed-out local docker version probe bypasses DockerUnavailable and falls back to the raw preflight error advising users to install and start Docker.
Legacy macOS Claude sessions with a non-default profile home are linked to the configured path in launch.json rather than ~/.claude, which Claude actually used when CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR was left unset.
Legacy local sessions whose recorded profile home directory does not exist at daemon startup receive no symlink or staged directory, leaving <worker_root>/profile absent.
credential_sync_targets runs synchronous symlink_metadata filesystem I/O for local sessions on the TUI dashboard event loop.
Refreshed launch configurations for linked legacy macOS Claude sessions enable subagent_tools without staged MCP configuration, disabling Claude's native Agent and Task tools with no replacement.
Adapter::new_session inserts the session ID into self.sessions before waiting for readiness, causing unanswered_refusal() to suppress the error exit status when provisioning fails or times out.
The post-resume prompt in acp_real_harness.py supplies the expected marker rather than testing pre-suspend conversation recall.
Client.stop() in acp_real_harness.py neither kills nor reaps the relay or adapter subprocesses when graceful EOF exit times out, leaving them running after cleanup.
Lab.cleanup() aborts session destruction on the first mj destroy failure or timeout, skipping remaining sessions before stopping the daemon.
`mj go` workspace selection does not reserve the hidden `default` name, causing `create_workspace` to fail in a directory named `default` or `Default`.
`mj new` reads the prompt (including stdin `-` or `--prompt-file`) and validates `--bundle`/`--project-directory` before checking for a required `--workspace`.
Excluding stopped/lost sessions from `session_count` makes a `default` workspace with only suspended history report `0 sessions`.
Renaming the visible `default` workspace and then removing its last session hides the renamed workspace while `refuse_legacy_default_name` blocks recreating that name.
The optional `list_workspaces()` lookup in `workspace_required` can hang indefinitely during a pending daemon upgrade.
`POST /api/v1/sessions` with `project_directory` and no `bundle_id` creates and persists a quick bundle before rejecting a workspace-less fresh instance with 409.
`POST /api/v1/workspaces` with `"default"` on a fresh instance returns HTTP 500 instead of a 4xx client error.

Mixed background task and shell counts (`1 task, 1 shell 50s`) overflow the 16-column minimized Sessions status line, dropping the elapsed time and truncating the shell label when queued prompts are present.
A fast adapter exit after emitting SessionStarted can record Failed in the launch registry before the outer task processes the queued SessionStarted event.
Launch registry eviction blindly removes the oldest entry even when it is still Starting and newer entries have already resolved.
acp::run awaits the ACP initialize response without a deadline, so a silently hung adapter still hits the viewer timeout.

The viewer's launch watcher ignores the Starting and Started(session_id) states returned by the new launch endpoint, so an unrelated session published by another client stops polling and hides a subsequent launch failure.

Provisioning creates worker roots with default permissions before the worker starts, so create_owner_only_directory in WorkerRootOwner::acquire leaves newly provisioned worker roots world-traversable.
Journal replacement and segment sealing reuse fixed .new paths with create(true) and truncate(true), preserving 0644 permissions if a pre-upgrade crash left a stale .new file.
Deferred log writes and the daemon startup lock still use plain fs::create_dir_all, which can create the data directory with 0755 if initial log directory creation fails transiently.
Clipped model and effort spans in the prompt title still render with clickable chip styling while registering no hitbox when they exceed the right border.
Clicking a prompt config chip opens the value picker without clearing keyboard focus on the View tasks or Sub-agents controls, which intercept keys before the picker.
Prompt config chips claim all mouse events including drag and release in component_handles_mouse, clearing active text selections dragged across a chip.
Prompt config chip hitboxes remain active when a centered autocomplete popup overlays the prompt title row in a short terminal.
attention_level returns Unreachable before checking for a failed review or failed findings handoff, downgrading failed reviews below other failures when the worker is unreachable.
The wide minimized Sessions pane title displays Attention: N without the most urgent level's glyph, making levels that share a color indistinguishable.
notification_body does not handle AttentionLevel::Unreachable, falling through to the completed-work wildcard arm and sending the last agent message or Finished.
sessions_block gates the minimized attention badge on saved PaneSize rather than whether the narrow layout automatically minimized the Sessions pane.
The mark-all-read confirmation notice mentions only questions and failures, omitting unreachable sessions that also stay flagged.
Using `catalog.exists()` in `stage_profile` silently treats permission or traversal errors on Muse's `model-catalog` path as an absent catalog.
`muse_data_dir` compares `own_home` and `home` lexically, misclassifying symlinked or non-canonical aliases of the native Muse home as private profiles.
A prompt arriving after the worker handshake marks the session `running` but before the first operational report sets `capabilities.prompt` is immediately rejected with 409.
The prompt readiness wait and submission hold no daemon upgrade activity permit, so an automatic daemon handoff can shut down the HTTP server and drop waiting prompts.
Cancelling an ACP prompt during the daemon's startup readiness wait does not withdraw the held prompt, so it is still dispatched to the harness once the worker attaches.
The side-source test in src/acp.rs still uses a 2-second timeout for PromptDone completion after raising its preceding ack wait to EVENT_DEADLINE.
The live-config test in src/acp.rs still uses a 5-second deadline in its config-persistence polling loop after raising its shutdown wait to EVENT_DEADLINE.
native_muse_turn panics on event or close timeouts without stopping and reaping the spawned ACP runtime and child processes before the caller's TempDir deletes the profile.
Claimed that the temporary directory and copied Muse auth.json are traversable or readable by other users on Unix under a 022 umask.
native_muse_turn ignores HarnessRestarting and resends CommandRequest::Prompt on every SessionStarted, so an adapter exit during the restored turn triggers a silent retry and extra provider turn.
Pinned field titles are rendered unwrapped in a single row and permanently clip when wider than the pane.
In 6- or 7-row ordinary question panes, reserving two body rows for the field title and control leaves zero rows for the request message.
ProcessGroup::kill_if_live skips signaling the process group once the shell leader exits, leaving backgrounded descendants alive.
supervise waits for stdout and stderr pipe EOF before publishing the child's exit status, hanging wait_for_exit when a background child inherits stdio.
TerminalRegistry::shutdown signals and awaits terminals sequentially with a 5-second timeout per terminal instead of signaling all groups first and bounding total teardown.
Configured session and profile environment variables are not passed to client terminal commands.
Checkpoint barriers can be marked ready while worker-owned client terminal commands are still running and modifying the workspace.
TerminalRegistry::output reads the buffer and releases its lock before reading exit status, allowing a poll to return an exit status with stale output.
TerminalBuffer caps raw bytes before lossy UTF-8 conversion (allowing up to 3x expansion) and rounds a zero limit up to 1.
shell_line leaves command unquoted even when args are supplied, breaking executable paths with spaces or shell metacharacters.
Client terminals run in separate process groups without a worker-lifetime supervisor, so bare-target worker termination or cleanup racing CloseApplied leaves terminals running on the host.
Terminal IDs reset to term-1 on every connection, causing resumed sessions to overwrite earlier terminal output in the projected transcript.
adopt_restarted_checkpoint_relay falls back to an unleased standalone connection when lease_connection fails, bypassing the actor's exclusive lifecycle lease.
worker_connect_needs_restart fails to match a broken pipe error during call_hello when the proxy exits before the hello frame is written.
open_checkpoint_relay leaves the managed session actor unleased while restarting the worker, allowing concurrent prompt dispatch before the checkpoint acquires its lease.
adopt_restarted_checkpoint_relay replaces the actor's newly synced connection with the older restarted proxy, causing AlreadyApplied projection failures if the actor applied newer events.

open_checkpoint_relay kills and restarts the worker immediately on relay proxy disconnected without first retrying a fresh proxy connection, risking interruption of live turns including during recovery checkpoints.

install_git_plan unconditionally requires and installs gh in every managed container even without a GitHub token, breaking custom images that have git without gh and lack root/sudo, a supported package manager, or network access.

use_github_https_urls rewrites non-GitHub SCP-style URLs and two-component relative paths into invalid https://github.com/ URLs because github_repository_from_origin accepts arbitrary owner/repo shorthand.
inject_github_token unconditionally appends --env GH_TOKEN=<token> after the target's configured environment variables, silently overriding an explicit GH_TOKEN set on the target.
inject_github_token passes the literal GitHub token in --env GH_TOKEN=<token> process arguments, exposing the credential in local container/ssh argv and remote podman argv.
install_git_plan uses single-value git config --global under set -eu, which fails if the image already has multi-valued GitHub credential helpers such as those created by gh auth setup-git.

ReviewDispatch::launch validates each request's hypothesis and then discards it when mapping requests to ReviewAgentId, so specialist reviewers never receive the supervisor's hypothesis in their prompt.
On SSH bare and AWS EC2 targets, the review dispatcher's relative command path never matches the worker's absolute worker_root, preventing Guardian preapproval for mj-review in both Codex and Claude.
Local filesystem path completions bypass the 5-second deadline and cancellation flag and can exhaust the shared 4-slot preflight pool.
Keyboard navigation in the scrollable path-suggestion list updates aria-selected without scrolling the highlighted option into view.
Blurring a path input hides the suggestion list but does not clear the debounce timer or abort an in-flight completion request.
The path-suggestion keydown handler intercepts ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter, and Escape during active IME composition.
The path input lacks combobox ARIA attributes linking it to the suggestion listbox and highlighted option.
JournalReadMode::Recover aborts the entire scan when a corrupt terminated record exceeds RELAY_EVENT_BYTE_BUDGET instead of draining to the next newline and continuing.
JournalReadMode::Recover and RelayJournalGap fields are unused outside tests, triggering dead_code warnings that break warning-free clippy builds.
RelayJournalGap.byte_len records line.len() instead of consumed, omitting the terminating newline byte from the reported gap range.
Filter recovery keys (Esc and state letters) are blocked when the Sessions action row (Create/Resume) has focus, including when a filter matches no sessions.
Filtering out all sessions of a collapsed project permanently removes its key from `collapsed_project_keys` during `clamp_selections`, expanding it when the filter is cleared.
Bracketed/clipboard paste is ignored while editing the Sessions search filter because `handle_paste` returns early whenever focus is not `Focus::Prompt`.
Greedy subsequence scoring in `subsequence_score` commits to the first occurrence of each character, ranking scattered matches above contiguous word matches.

Commands run from the palette that also have pane shortcuts (such as Create session and Search sessions) are never recorded in Recent because `dispatch_command` gates recording on `pane_keys.is_empty()`.

Live session activity updates can exclude the selected session from a state filter without calling `clamp_selections`, leaving `selected_session_id` pointing to a hidden row that `selected_session()` cannot resolve.
Unhiding Create session from `PALETTE_HIDDEN` does not make it searchable in the palette when Targets, Quota, or Workspaces has focus because its scope is `Scope::Sessions`.
Typing a new palette query preserves the previously selected command ID from the Recent group even when it drops to the bottom via a description match, causing Enter to run the wrong command.
`select_active_session` checks filtered `ordered_sessions()`, so creating or resuming a session while a filter excludes it silently fails to select the new session.
`apply_worker_summary` replaces `summarized_unread_agent_messages` without pruning `unread_agent_message_sequences`, double-counting live-polled unread messages after a worker reconnect.
Detaching from a conversation updates `last_viewed_event_sequence` in controller state without refreshing worker poll targets, so reconnect summaries recount already-read messages.
`apply_worker_summary` unconditionally installs `summary.unread_agent_messages` even when the session is currently selected and visible on the dashboard.
`SessionSummary` scans the entire event log in reverse and clones/deserializes every adapter payload to compute `session_title` on every summary request for untitled sessions.
Pressing Delete on an active session hydrated from a 10-entry tail bypasses the `DESTROY` confirmation and immediately destroys the session if no assistant message remains in the tail.
Loading full history on warm-worker checkout advances the client cursor past newly replayed events without notifying `recovery_context`, causing missed automatic recovery checkpoints.
Summary hydration and live polling use different message-stream boundaries, so an intervening plan update closes the stream in `SessionSummary` while leaving it open in live polling.
The rename dialog renders identically whether the title field or the Save button has keyboard focus, even though typing, Backspace, and paste only work when the field is focused.
Holding Enter to start an import can immediately cancel it because `Mode::Importing` treats repeated Enter events as `CancelImport`.

Native wiki resume discards the indexed transcript path and searches only the stock harness home, failing for sessions indexed from non-default profile homes or importing a same-ID session from the stock home.

Adding `DaemonAction::WikiSession` and `GET /api/v1/wiki/sessions/{wiki_id}` without bumping `PROTOCOL_VERSION` causes upgraded clients to reuse an older running daemon and turn 404s into missing-session errors.

Issuing HTTP `POST /api/v1/sessions/{id}/resume` immediately after `PersistImportedSession` races with async viewer snapshot publication and can fail with `unknown session` after persisting the import.
Restoring an archived wiki session without `--workspace-id` sends `None`, which the restore endpoint turns into an empty string that `SessionRecord::validate` rejects.

Noninteractive `mj resume --wiki` hardcodes `allow_dirty_local` and `allow_omitted_non_git` to `false` while `ResumeArgs` exposes neither flag, blocking agents from acknowledging import safety warnings.
`mj resume --wiki <native-id> --json` prints plain-text import progress lines to stdout before the JSON payload, producing invalid JSON.
Native wiki resume calls `resolve_store_workspace(None)` which tells multi-workspace users to pass `--workspace NAME`, but `Command::Resume` ignores `--workspace`.

Restoring archived container or other bundle-backed sessions fails because their wiki rows have no `project_directory` and `restore_wiki_session` unconditionally passes `Some(project_directory)`, which registration rejects for non-bare targets.
The web viewer does not catch or surface 500 logout persistence failures, and subsequent 401s hide the logout button so users cannot retry durable revocation.
Logout skips recording a revocation when the presented signed cookie has already expired, allowing an in-flight renewed cookie to restore access.
Already-open cookie-authenticated /api/v1/events SSE streams continue delivering session events after the viewer logs out and is revoked.
Revocation expiry uses only the presented cookie expiry and current session_ttl, allowing previously renewed cookies from a longer session_ttl to outlive the revocation.
Dropping the held MoveSourceRelay lease on proxy sync failure lets the session actor reconnect and drain non-refused deferred submissions such as GoalControl before the worker is restarted.
Retrying a Move after queue_admission_started skips drop(source_relay), keeping the running destination's actor leased through source cleanup and queue replay.
Stacked failure notices hardcode the Unicode middle dot instead of using the active symbol set's separator.
Transcript and second-opinion row caches do not include the symbol set in their cache key, leaving stale glyphs and mismatched gutters after switching Symbols in Setup.
In the Monochrome theme, disabled controls and disabled session actions render with the exact same style as unfocused enabled ones.
`truncate_line_to_width` reserves only one cell for the ellipsis even though the ASCII ellipsis `..` is two cells wide, causing truncated lines to exceed their requested width.
Composer footer hints hardcode ` · ` while splitting on `theme::footer_separator()`, breaking ASCII rendering and width-fitting.
The Recent messages modal truncates each notice to one line inside an 80-column popup with no wrapping or horizontal scrolling, permanently hiding the end of long failure messages.
Notice history deduplication matches only consecutive text, dropping updated timestamps and severity upgrades when identical text recurs after dismissal or with a different severity.
Stacked failure counting compares incoming failures against the formatted count banner instead of the raw latest failure text, inflating the count on repeated identical failures.
Compact session rows split git status text at the second space, truncating `detached HEAD` to `detached` when counters do not fit.
Several UI surfaces still emit hardcoded Unicode glyphs instead of reading from the active ASCII symbol table.
ASCII quota bars shrink by one column when a fractional cell rounds down to empty, misaligning the closing rail and percentage.
Relative notice ages in the Recent messages modal do not tick while idle because `RenderClockSignature` omits the notice log.
Pinning the accepted Codex model reads only explicit override maps, overwriting any login-shell `CODEX_CONFIG` with a model-only object.
The ACP supervisor spec is written only once at worker or reviewer startup, so in-worker bridge restarts reuse a stale model pin after a model change.
YOLO auto-approval uses the overly broad is_plan_permission heuristic, diverting ordinary tool requests whose titles or nested inputs contain plan keywords into interactive plan review.
Claims the existing #conversation-side max-height: 25dvh and overflow-y: auto rule creates a nested scroll container on phones.
Fixed 138px right padding on the phone summary clips the third count in 'Tasks 1 · Shells 1 · Queue 1' on 320px viewports.
composerActionPointerDown is only cleared on pointerup/pointercancel inside promptForm, so releasing a mouse drag outside the form leaves composer actions stuck visible.
Tabbing from an empty editor to Attach or Send on phone widths clears composer-has-intent and hides the focused toolbar button.
The commit modifies shell assets (viewer.html, viewer.css, viewer.js) without bumping service-worker.js CACHE_VERSION, allowing a partial offline reload to pair new HTML/CSS with old JS.
Expanded combobox popups do not take hit-testing precedence over later-registered form controls they visually cover.
ComboBox::render paints a shorter preview text over an existing list row without clearing trailing cells, leaving leftover characters and a second dropdown glyph.
Pressing Ctrl-S while a Setup choice combobox is open collapses the popup without closing the editor, leaving the choice editor stuck and causing Escape to dismiss all of Setup.
Review settings comboboxes track pending selection by numeric index, so opening Model or Effort while discovery is loading can commit the wrong option once discovery replaces the list.
delete_empty_workspace_at allows deleting the reserved 'default' workspace when empty, breaking all subsequent session and prompt writes.
assign_new_session_workspace_at checks and updates workspace_id non-atomically, allowing concurrent callers to silently overwrite a session's workspace.
assign_new_session_workspace_at treats any session in the 'default' workspace as newly created, allowing existing or migrated default-workspace sessions to be reassigned.
Adding the workspace_id column to session_contexts breaks existing tests that use three-value positional INSERT INTO session_contexts VALUES (...).

version_thirteen_restores_checkpointed_lost_sessions_to_recoverable_errors fails because downgrading a v14 database to user_version 12 leaves v14 objects intact and reopening re-runs non-idempotent CREATE TABLE workspaces.
legacy_sessions_are_migrated_into_the_default_workspace_without_copying_state creates a v14 database before inserting the session, so it never tests migrating a preexisting v13 session.
Workspace names within the 64-character limit whose Unicode lowercasing expands past 64 code points pass normalize_workspace_name but fail the SQLite CHECK constraint on name_key.
normalize_workspace_name uses str::to_lowercase() instead of Unicode case folding, so case-equivalent Greek sigma variants ('ΟΣ' and 'οσ') get distinct uniqueness keys.
Pinned worker binaries copied into the content-addressed cache are never pruned or reclaimed across daemon lifetimes, causing unbounded disk growth.
Awaiting synchronous worker binary copies and fsyncs before binding the daemon listener can exceed the client's 8-second startup timeout.
Local container worker recovery selects std::env::consts::ARCH instead of the container's architecture.

copy_worker_source_to_cache stages and flushes a full temporary copy before checking whether the digest already exists in the cache, failing restarts on low disk space and freezing the error for the daemon lifetime.
download_worker switched to the pinned digest cache path without falling back to previously verified downloads in workers/<version>/<triple>/hel.
Reusing an existing content-addressed cache entry preserves non-executable permissions from an earlier capture even after source permissions are fixed.
copy_worker_source_to_cache does not verify that the source file remained unchanged during the streaming read, allowing a concurrent in-place overwrite to publish a torn binary.
Stored summary queries use SQLite's space-only trim() and LIMIT 1 instead of Rust's whitespace and terminal-sanitization semantics, hiding earlier agent answers and inflating unread counts.
load_materialized_session_summary_from runs four separate autocommit queries instead of one SQLite read transaction, allowing torn summaries during concurrent relay replay.
last_materialized_user_message restricts candidate rows to stable_id prefixes user:* and user-*, dropping user previews for valid imported canonical transcripts with other stable IDs.
Applying a delayed startup summary restores a stale unread count captured at startup and can overwrite a full projection at the same event ordinal.
The minimized two-session Active pane height includes the second row's trailing spacer for a third same-project session, prematurely triggering Terminal too small.
Setting default Cargo target to x86_64-unknown-linux-musl in .cargo/config.toml breaks CI jobs that only install the runner's native target.
Prepending default SSH options in ssh_args_with_identity overrides user-configured ssh_args and ssh_directory_completions's 3-second timeout because OpenSSH uses first-match-wins.
Failed provisioning skips container cleanup when git install or clone fails inside provision.execute(), and cleanup_failed_provision skips SshPodman containers entirely.
github_repository_from_origin falls back to treating any single-slash string as owner/repo shorthand, misparsing non-GitHub SCP remotes and relative Git remotes as GitHub repositories.
collect_local_repositories uses HEAD as base_commit, causing collect_git_snapshot to omit unpushed local commits and making restore fail on fresh clones.
read_claude_transcript never calls finish_imported_turn, leaving interrupted Claude sessions in WorkerPhase::Running on restore so they reject subsequent prompts.
locate_kimi_session compares --session verbatim against session_<uuid> directory names, rejecting the bare UUID documented by the CLI.
locate_kimi_session --latest compares session directory modification times instead of transcript/state file activity, selecting the wrong session when an older session is continued.
collect_codex_candidates propagates JSON parse failures from any rollout in the Codex tree before matching the requested session UUID.
Import commands load full config and state before user confirmation and archive collection, then unconditionally overwrite both files without locking or merging, losing concurrent updates.
Claimed missing resolution of relative/tilde workspace_root before deriving Claude/Kimi native keys in restore_checkpoint.
session_projection() locks self.controller and calls active_lifecycles(), which locks the same non-reentrant mutex again, deadlocking web/phone snapshot publication and blocking the daemon.

cancel_lifecycle and lifecycle views read the periodically refreshed cached self.controller instead of synchronizing with the close task's Destroying transition, allowing Alt-X to abort teardown after the point of no return.
Interrupted-close retries routed through recover_interrupted_close_managed do not persist teardown errors after clearing last_error on Closing->Destroying, disabling Stop retry in the TUI.

The post-stop verification pipeline in `stop_worker_daemon_script` passes the worker match string to `grep -F`, allowing `ps` to capture the `grep` process itself and spuriously report that the worker is still running.
Sub-agent effort validation and inheritance check against the chosen profile's default-model capabilities instead of the selected model's effort choices.
`resolve_subagent_selection` reads the parent's current model and effort only from `operational.config`, missing live defaults present only in `operational.config_options`.
Requiring a model on every spawn and passing it to `apply_followup` breaks Muse sub-agents because Muse's ACP bridge exposes no live model selector.
Spawn profile discovery awaits every eligible profile (up to 300s each) even when a profile is pinned, exceeding the 120s MCP reply timeout and risking duplicate child spawns on retry.
Replaying an in-flight MCP `spawn` after a daemon restart re-runs profile selection before checking the durable registration and passes the new selection to `start_followup`.
Handback requests do not carry the originating turn identity, so a delayed request can be attached to a later turn.
Both wait paths omit queued prompts from `in_flight` when calling `report_state`, so a reminder queued longer than the 30s grace period falls back prematurely.
Skipping a reminder when `in_flight` is non-empty still marks the turn noticed, leaving waits stuck in `Pending` if the queued item drains without a new turn or is removed.
`remind_subagent_to_hand_back` submits the reminder unconditionally without rechecking whether the child is still idle on the same turn.
A transport error after worker acceptance causes `remind_subagent_to_hand_back` to immediately record the reminder as failed, letting waits fall back while the reminder runs.
Adding `handback_tool` to `SubagentRecord` (which has `deny_unknown_fields`) breaks `RuntimeSnapshot` decoding for protocol-33 clients without bumping the protocol version.
`hel_kill_tree` unconditionally sends `SIGKILL` to every snapshotted PGID, including a legacy worker's inherited process group.
`hel_kill_tree` signals every snapshotted PID and PGID after a 2-second grace period without revalidating process birth identity against PID/PGID reuse.
`hel_snapshot_tree` silently swallows `ps` and `awk` failures into an empty snapshot, letting cleanup delete files while separate-group harnesses remain alive.
Taking a single process-tree snapshot before `TERM` misses descendants spawned in a new process group after the snapshot.
`hel_tree_running` checks only recorded PIDs and ignores recorded harness PGIDs, so helpers forked into a harness's group after the snapshot can survive cleanup.
The new teardown regression test calls unbounded `leader.wait()` before checking whether the stop script succeeded, hanging the test on script failure.
Extracting only file_name() from profile.authentication_marker() strips nested directories (credentials/, v2/) for Kimi and ZCode workers.
Catalog cache entries share the (profile, "") primary key with default profile discovery, causing them to overwrite each other.
stage_codex_catalog caches the raw HTTP 200 response before parsing it, overwriting the last valid catalog with malformed or invalid bodies.
ZCode quota refresh returns an unsupported error while the ZCode harness is still present in this milestone.
Custom Codex providers returning standard OpenAI-style {"data":[...]} model lists fail catalog parsing and cannot launch.
Cached catalogs expire after the 24-hour profile_config_cache TTL.
Inline experimental_bearer_token providers skip catalog staging while profile validation still forbids user-supplied model_catalog_json.
Rewriting a staged config.toml copied from a read-only source fails with permission denied.
fetch_catalog_over_https constructs and drops reqwest::blocking::Client inside Tokio runtime contexts, panicking on resume and subagent provisioning.
reconcile_session reads canonical auth.json before checking authenticates_with_api_key, so an unreadable leftover credential file aborts skills and GitHub token sync.
quota_refresh_profiles and credential_sync_targets now read and parse Codex config.toml synchronously on the TUI event loop.
Literal "model" and "effort" lookups in restore_checkpoint_with_native_state drop selectors archived under harness-specific option IDs such as reasoning_effort.
Native restore seeds accepted_config from the projection's advertised configuration rather than the relay's accepted configuration, pinning unaccepted defaults and fallback models.
